description_zh: 不是问卷，是审计。先从日记/简历挖事实，再按批量问卷或深度访谈补齐缺口，全程证据分级、自欺检测与反宿命论证伪，最终产出带数字、带 14 天受控实验、带放弃清单的规划，并在第 14 天强制闭环复盘。
description_en: An audit, not a questionnaire. Mines facts from your own records first, interviews in either batch or deep mode, grades every conclusion by evidence level, stress-tests self-limiting beliefs, and delivers a plan with a 14-day controlled experiment and a mandatory day-14 review.
